row: "Alexi Makaritis is registered with the International Association of Animal Therapists (IAAT) and is qualified by The College of Animal Physiotherapy, U.K and Oxford Brookes University, U.K. Physiotherapy and rehabilitation for animals, dogs, cats and horses. Hydrotherapy treadmill available with heated, clean, filtered water and other latest technology machines available such as electro-muscular stimulation H-Wave, laser, pulsed electromagnetic field therapy and therapeutic exercises. Physiotherapy and rehabilitation for animals suffering from post operation, arthritis, neurological conditions such as disc prolapse, hip dysplasia, elbow dysplasia. Physiotherapy is non invasive."
